accepted: The rejected 512-draw bounded-search contract remains reachable but is superseded by canonical V2.
Conditional-on-success rejection sampling uniformity was correctly distinguished from false-negative existence classification.
Single-block interval algebra provides an exact transformation for windows wholly inside one ungapped affine chain block.
The initial 0-vs-0 test was correctly recognized as vacuous and expanded to non-empty cases.
On the reported 10-edge x 2-side sample, seven non-empty comparisons matched brute-force liftOver element-for-element.
Phase B and Stage 4 remain sealed.

blocking_finding.finding: The sampler deliberately restricts to 5-kb windows wholly contained in one ungapped chain block. The frozen C3 rule does not contain that restriction; it accepts any interval that liftOver maps uniquely, same chromosome, exact length, and exact reverse round-trip.
blocking_finding.consequence: A cross-block interval could in principle satisfy the frozen C3 gate. Such a start would be present in the brute-force/frozen admissible set but absent from the algebra set. Spot-check equality on 20 or 64 edge-side comparisons is evidence, not a proof of completeness over all 20,709 edges.
blocking_finding.important_distinction: The current implementation cannot admit an invalid single-block control, but it can potentially omit a valid boundary-crossing control. That would reintroduce false-negative structural classification, although much more narrowly than the rejected 512-draw design.

required_repair.name: EXACT_BOUNDARY_SUPPLEMENT
required_repair.rationale: Preserve fast interval algebra for block interiors while making completeness exact relative to liftOver.
algorithm: Compute the existing exact single-block admissible set A_interior.

For every forward-chain block boundary intersecting the finite side/distance band, enumerate only hg19 starts s for which [s,s+5000) crosses that boundary. Such starts lie in [boundary-4999, boundary-1], intersected with the finite band and promoter-specific exclusion.
Deduplicate those boundary candidate starts because a 5-kb window may intersect more than one nearby boundary.
Run the actual frozen liftOver v479 forward mapping with ambiguity detection on those candidate windows.
Run actual hg38->hg19 reverse lift and require exact return to the original hg19 coordinates.
Apply the authoritative hg38 Nott PU.1 and NIH-CARD consensus-overlap gates.
Final exact admissible set A = A_interior UNION A_boundary, disjoint-normalized.
Uniform sampling uses exact cumulative integer cardinality over A.
required_repair.completeness_argument: Every 5-kb start is either wholly inside one forward chain block or crosses at least one forward block boundary/gap. The first class is handled by exact algebra; the second is exhaustively enumerated by the boundary supplement. Therefore no source start in the finite frozen band is omitted merely because it crosses a chain boundary.

test_requirements: Retain all eight canonical deterministic fixtures.
Add a fixture where a boundary-crossing interval DOES pass exact C3 and must be recovered only by the boundary supplement.
Add a fixture where a boundary-crossing interval maps but changes length or fails reverse round-trip and must be rejected.
For the canonical 32 deterministic real edges x both sides, compare FINAL A_interior UNION A_boundary against brute-force liftOver start-for-start; zero mismatches.
The 32-edge test must include non-empty cases; receipt reports count of non-empty comparisons.
Retain uniformity chi-square and all six failure-path tests from the canonical test contract.

additional_code_review_notes.chain_parser_scope: The parser currently skips non-'+' query-strand chains rather than reproducing general liftOver semantics. For the exact interior path, the producer must either prove that all relevant source loci lie in supported '+' blocks or handle minus-strand blocks correctly. The brute-force boundary supplement does not cure omitted interior minus-strand loci.
additional_code_review_notes.recommendation: Before Phase A, report the fraction/count of the entire frozen candidate-band source space falling in unsupported chain orientations. If nonzero, implement general strand-aware affine mapping or route those starts through an exact liftOver supplement as well.
